changes: Relieved the upper inner C-frame transition while preserving its outer silhouette and lower guide seats; replaced the interfering rectangular nosepiece gearbox with an inclined bearing housing above the rotor.
Fitted a 0.7 mm specimen carrier between the unchanged deck and slide, and seated spring clips on the slide surface.
Added objective front-glass/shoulder/sleeve and slide-clip contacts; open convex frame compounds preserve the repaired throat.
baseline_findings: Detailed fitted objectives intersected fixed exteriors at all 80 tested indexed/intermediate turret poses.
Carrier and spring clips penetrated the slide by 0.1 and 0.2 mm. Front glass extended 0.26 mm beyond native contact, leaving six sampled unsafe poses without a contact.
limitations: Exterior dimensions, loads, material properties and holder/stand relief dimensions remain reconstruction estimates; no manufacturer CAD or metrology is claimed.
Collision checks cover the named assemblies and finite sampled poses, not every possible configuration or every inserted screw/bearing seam.
Native contact is numerically soft; contact regressions measure and limit penetration rather than interpreting it as calibrated material indentation.
The optical-axis check is geometric. Internal optical prescriptions and lower condenser transmission are not ray-traced.
Existing cable models and renderer behavior are preserved; these repairs do not add robot-driven cable dynamics.
